name: display: flex
description: Turns an element into a flex container, laying its direct children out along a single row or column axis.
notes: inline-flex behaves the same but the container itself participates in layout as an inline element.

name: flex-direction
description: Sets the main axis along which flex items are laid out inside a flex container.

name: justify-content
syntax: justify-content: flex-start | flex-end | center | space-between | space-around | space-evenly;
description: Aligns flex items along the main axis of the flex container.

name: align-items
syntax: align-items: stretch | flex-start | flex-end | center | baseline;
description: Aligns flex items along the cross axis of the flex container, for a single line of items.

name: align-content
syntax: align-content: flex-start | flex-end | center | space-between | space-around | stretch;
description: Aligns multiple lines of flex items along the cross axis when the container has extra space and flex-wrap is enabled.
notes: Has no visible effect unless there is more than one flex line (e.g. flex-wrap: wrap with items that wrap).

name: flex-wrap
description: Controls whether flex items are forced onto one line or can wrap onto multiple lines.

name: flex-grow
description: Sets how much a flex item grows relative to its siblings to fill available extra space along the main axis.
notes: Default is 0, meaning items don't grow past their base size unless explicitly told to.

name: flex-shrink
description: Sets how much a flex item shrinks relative to its siblings when there isn't enough room on the main axis.
notes: Default is 1, so items shrink by default — set to 0 to prevent an item from shrinking below its basis.

name: flex-basis
description: Sets the initial main-axis size of a flex item before flex-grow/flex-shrink are applied.

name: flex
description: Shorthand for flex-grow, flex-shrink, and flex-basis in one declaration.
notes: flex: 1 is a common shorthand for flex: 1 1 0%, making items grow and shrink equally.

name: align-self
syntax: align-self: auto | flex-start | flex-end | center | baseline | stretch;
description: Overrides align-items for a single flex item, aligning it individually on the cross axis.

name: order
description: Changes the visual order in which a flex item appears, independent of its position in the source markup.
notes: Default order is 0; items are laid out from lowest to highest order value.

name: gap
description: Sets spacing between flex items without adding margin to the items themselves.
notes: Also works in grid containers — a single gap value applies to both rows and columns.

name: flex-flow
description: Shorthand for setting flex-direction and flex-wrap in a single declaration.
